details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:1340-1413 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `UNREACHABLE: security-hold` block is only written to review_issues.txt when the finding is raised again in the current round (`[ "${status}" = "unreachable" ] && [ -n "${current_block}" ]`). Once the finding is absent, nothing gates the PR on the hold: the consolidator bullet in prompts/review-consolidator.txt:62-66 says "never re-raise it as must-fix" with no security_hold exception, the scoped reviewers drop `unreachable` rows, and the clean-marker gate in scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:442-482 never reads review_unreachable_all.tsv.
  WHY: `review-autofix-clean:v1` is posted (and the PR may auto-merge) while a security finding is still open, which breaks "a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge". Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it MAJOR; gemini, minimax and glm rated it BLOCKER.
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:31 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The added `unreachable-followup` bullet (also mirrored at prompts/_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:24) brings this DEFAULT-tier prompt to 251 lines, over the 250-line limit that tests/prompt_size_budget.py enforces.
  WHY: The required `quick / static-checks` check already fails on head bc33bb74 with "FAIL: prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt: 251 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250", so the PR cannot merge.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:55-57 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_no_result_split_enabled()` turns on only for the literal string `true` (default `false`). scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:948-958 treats anything except `false|0|no|off` as on (default `true`).
  WHY: With `1`, `yes`, `on` or `True`, the ledger feature is active but cancelled and timed-out runs stay in `failed[]`, so the ledger and the reviewer/editor context disagree. Severity disagreement: sonnet and luna rated it NIT; gemini, minimax and glm rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:791-799 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `unreachable_path_candidate` regex `^[A-Za-z0-9._][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$` at line 796 rejects paths that contain spaces or parentheses. Such paths never get an `UNREACHABLE_PATH_REASON` entry, and the classifier at lines 1289-1294 falls through to reachable.
  WHY: Findings on those paths, security ones included, skip the unreachable/security-hold classification and repeat every round. Severity disagreement: luna rated it NIT; minimax and glm rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:1202 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The regex ^[A-Za-z0-9._][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$ rejects paths with spaces or parentheses.
  WHY: Security findings on files like scripts/ci.sh (deprecated) bypass the safety net, so the autofix loop repeats. (Same root cause as the 791-799 entry, but the cited line does not overlap, so it was not merged.)
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:727 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In editor_reachable, a `FILE:` value that is not a repository file is refused as `unsupported_type` and the ledger marks it `unreachable` (sticky). Examples: `N/A`, `none`, `general`, `multiple`, a directory such as `scripts`, or `PR-body`. unreachable_path_candidate in scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh (lines 791-800) only rejects empty strings, "unknown" and disallowed characters.
  WHY: PR-wide or task-gap findings the editor could address become `UNREACHABLE ISSUE` stubs that go to the follow-up issue and never start another fix round, which silently defers real work.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1213-1222 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_unreachable_followup_sync, the follow-up issue number is stored only when the sed parse of `gh issue create` stdout finds `/issues/N` and the ledger write-back succeeds (the write-back exits 1 when `header_done` is false). Otherwise the entries stay pending even though the issue already exists.
  WHY: The in-step retry and every later round run `gh issue create` again and open duplicate `ai:clarification` follow-up issues, which breaks "one follow-up issue per PR". Severity disagreement: sonnet and glm rated it NIT; minimax rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input and from the round's open-issue count."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh editor prompt assembly (lines 1706-1736: the reviewer_bundle.txt embed and the "authoritative findings source" instruction), plus the round approval inputs
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only review_issues.txt is rewritten into stubs (line 1469). The prompt still embeds the unfiltered `${RUNTIME_DIR}/reviewer_bundle.txt` (lines 1706-1708) and says "Treat ${RUNTIME_DIR}/reviewer_bundle.txt as the authoritative findings source" (line 1735). The stub text at lines 1635-1641 is advisory. No hunk filters the bundle or changes the open-issue count, so the editor can still edit `.github/workflows/**` and trip write_guard_check in review_commit_changes.sh (line 301 or 521).
- requirement: "It is shown in the PR review comment under its own heading and passed to the review-blocked judge."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh::render_review_rb_prior_round_decisions_file (line 707 flag gate) and the judge env in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2103
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `unreachable-followup` / `followup=` / `security_hold=` rendering sits behind `! flag_enabled "${REVIEW_LEDGER_REREVIEW_ENABLED:-0}"` (lines 706-709). The workflow defaults that switch to 'false' (review_autofix.yml:2103), and review_consolidate.sh line 318 has the same gate. In the default configuration the judge never receives the unreachable handoff or security_hold.
- requirement: "Cancelled or timed-out CI jobs are not findings at all and must not be given to the editor as one."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh CI / LINT CHECK-RUN FAILURES role text (lines 2587 and 2663; minimax cites 2326)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only the editor-prompt header in scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1677 mentions `no_result[]`. The reviewer text still says every failed check-run is a concrete defect to surface, with no `no_result` carve-out, so cancelled shards can reach the editor through reviewer_bundle.txt. Sonnet notes review_run_reviewers.sh is outside the plan grant, so this is partly a scope note.
- requirement: "A security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh persistence/filtering and the review-blocked judge or the clean-marker gate in scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: When a previously unreachable finding is absent from the current review, its status is kept only in ledger metadata and review_unreachable_all.tsv (scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:1371-1412), and no blocking finding is restored to review_issues.txt. The clean-marker conditions at scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:464-481 do not check for a persisted security hold. The judge's prior-decision input is off by default.
- requirement: "linked from the PR with Refs, never with an auto-close keyword (§19)" (issue body, Approach step 2)
  expected_change_site: PR description body of this autofix PR
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description begins "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/10057"; the title and changelog fragment use `Refs #10057`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this: #10057 is the PR's own linked issue, not an `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh (absent-entry loop around lines 1371-1381 and 1401-1413), together with scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh lines 464-482 and scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh line 2163 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The security-hold annotation is only added when the finding is in the current round. Later scoped reviewers drop `unreachable` rows, the consolidator bullet has no security_hold exception, and the clean-marker gate never reads review_unreachable_all.tsv or UNREACHABLE_SECURITY.
  WHY: The PR is marked `review-autofix-clean:v1` while a security finding is open, which breaks the §1 constraint. Suggested fix: set `clean_marker_reason="unreachable_security_hold"` when field 5 is `true`, and add "unless security_hold=true" to the consolidator bullet.
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:31 (also prompts/_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new `unreachable-followup` bullet brings the prompt to 251 lines, over the 250-line DEFAULT budget in tests/prompt_size_budget.py.
  WHY: `quick / static-checks` already fails on head bc33bb74. Suggested fix: fold the sentence into the line-30 bullet and make the same edit in the template.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py (editor_reachable, `reason = _path_rejection_reason(name)` branch) and scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh (unreachable_path_candidate, about lines 791-800) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `FILE:` values that are not repository files (`N/A`, `none`, a directory, `PR-body`) are refused as "unsupported_type" (line 727) and marked `unreachable`, sticky.
  WHY: Work the editor could do is moved to the follow-up issue and never fixed. Suggested fix: treat as reachable when the reason is `unsupported_type` and `(host / name)` is not an existing regular file.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py (`_no_result_split_enabled()`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The collector accepts only "true"; the ledger (about line 953) and review_unreachable_followup_sync accept anything except false|0|no|off.
  WHY: With `1`, `yes` or `on`, the cancelled-CI split is silently off while the rest of the feature is on. Suggested fix: accept `true|1|yes|on`.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh review_unreachable_followup_sync, about lines 1213-1222 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The issue number is stored only if the stdout URL parses and the write-back succeeds (the write-back exits 1 when `header_done` is false). The retry in review_autofix_step_apply_fixes_editor.sh (line 160) and later rounds rerun `gh issue create`.
  WHY: Duplicate `ai:clarification` issues are created, which breaks "one follow-up issue per PR". Suggested fix: log `outcome=orphan` and still write `UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ISSUE` when a number was parsed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input and from the round's open-issue count."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, editor prompt ass
